name: ngx-edu-sharing-rendering-web-component
//: We use --deploy-url here although Angular complains it is deprecated since this seems to be
the only way to get Angular to load lazy scripts from a route that differs from base HREF as
given by index.html (which belongs to the host page and we don't control).

scripts.preview: ng build --configuration=development rendering-service && npm run serve
scripts.publish-npm: npm run build && cp {package.json,README.md} ../../dist/web-components/rendering-service && cd ../../dist/web-components/rendering-service && npm publish
